description: Find where to watch a movie or show, including on the viewer's saved services. Resolve names with search_titles first, then pass up to ten exact IDs. Returns providers, offer types, observation dates and availability freshness. With personal access, also returns streaming_preferences.services and matches_saved_service on each offer. Lead with matching included offers; matching rentals and purchases still cost extra. Use saved services without asking the viewer to repeat them. Subscription, free/ad-supported, rental and purchase are separate. An empty or stale result does not prove worldwide unavailability. No ReelRecs account required for public offers.

country.description: Use the viewer's known two-letter country, such as US or GB. If unknown, US is the default; identify that country in the answer.
country.title: Country

title_ids.description: Copy exact title IDs from search_titles or other ReelRecs results. Resolve names and versions first.
title_ids.title: Title Ids
